name: loop-coder
description: Agile Kanban web app with an MCP server that an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code…) works through until the board is done.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @loop/shared && npm run build -w @loop/api && npm run build -w @loop/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @loop/api && npm run typecheck -w @loop/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @loop/api && npm run test -w @loop/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && npm run test:coverage -w @loop/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @loop/api
